inputs.support_excerpt: Polls point the same way. The Silver Bulletin generic-ballot average gives Democrats an 8.9-point lead (updated 2 November). PollCheck has Democrats at 51.1% and Republicans at 42.8%, an 8.3-point lead (updated 2 November). Some are less sure about the Senate: Wolfe Research's own estimate put Democratic control at 49% (CNBC, 30 October).
